messages:
Eloise: woke up to 155M ARR. heart skipped. tiny rooftop toast tonight at 6? mini moon pins and jasmine tea? :crescent_moon: :tada:

Tom: i'm 100% in. i'll bring string lights and a slow-jam playlist. can we do a short 1-min shoutout for teams?

Rico: congrats all!! shoutout to the autoscale patch that kept p99 sane. :raised_hands: :rocket:

Nina: quick food poll  react with :cookie: for cookies, :tea: for jasmine tea, :fruit: for fruit cups. closes in 10m.

Sami: Ops-bot, can you block rooftop 6-7pm and note catering drop at 5:30?

Ops-bot: Rooftop event created: "155M Mini Moon Toast" 6-7pm. Capacity: 30. Catering: cookies + tea + fruit. (automated)

Eloise: merch note: limited moon pins + small sticker sheets. volunteers to assemble at 5:10? need 3 people.

Tom: i'll help assemble. Sami can help pack too.

Rico: meme drop: "me at 3am tuning batch size -> checks ARR at dawn" [img] :joy:

Nina: poll tally so far: :cookie: 7, :tea: 5, :fruit: 2. cookies win. ordering now. :cookie:

Eloise: shoutouts in-thread please so i can include them in the toast slide. i'll start: "huge thanks to autoscale, release, and QA night crew."

Sami: "benchmarks and infra for keeping latency calm."

Rico: "docs for last-minute clarity."

Eloise: perfect. if you're remote and want a pin, drop an emoji and we'll mail one. see you at 6 for tiny pins and tea. :confetti_ball:
